name: Spread
description: Width by frequency: the bass held in the middle, the top opened wide, on a curve with points to drag, and it can make width where a sound has none.

params.name: Low
params.description: Width of the bottom of the sound. All the way down the bass sits in the middle and stays firm; halfway is as it came in; up is wider.

params.name: Mid
params.description: Width of the middle of the sound, between the two splits. Halfway leaves it as it came in; down narrows it and up widens it.

params.name: High
params.description: Width of the top of the sound. Up spreads the air and shimmer out to the sides; halfway is as it came in; all the way down the top is in the middle.

params.name: Low split
params.description: Where the bottom ends and the middle begins. Raise it to hold more of the body of the sound to the width set by Low.

params.name: High split
params.description: Where the middle ends and the top begins. Lower it to give more of the sound the width set by High.

params.name: Slope
params.description: How one region passes into the next. Down the widths blend into each other over a broad stretch; up each region keeps to itself.

params.name: Make
params.description: Makes width where a sound has none, by scattering its middle to the sides. It acts only where a region is set wider than it came, so a mono sound opens there too.

params.name: Smear
params.description: How far in time the made width is scattered. Down it stays tight against each note; up it hangs a soft haze at the edges.

params.name: Safe
params.description: Holds the sides under the middle so the sound keeps its body on one speaker. Up holds harder; all the way down nothing is held. It never narrows what came in.

params.name: Output
params.description: The level going out, to make up for what a wider or narrower picture adds or takes.

origin.note: Mid and side; the side passes two stages of a three region split that sums to its input, the made width is an allpass scatter of the middle under a second curve of what each region has over 1.
